reviews.title: 5 Stars 🌟
reviews.text: Absolutely love the app!! It keeps me accountable & moving my body everyday! Would highly recommend to everyone!

reviews.title: 5 stars
reviews.text:
Excellent app and creator. The messaging is very positive and kind. Plenty of videos available for all and very accessible and inclusive. Guided walks and runs, yoga, Pilates, cardio, etc. 
no bugs to report.

reviews.title: Who knew?
reviews.text: I’m a person who is pretty anti-cardio and specifically anti-running. Howeveerrrr my wife and all of my friends are runners, so they’ve peer pressured me into it. Having Camilla in my ears for the first day of 5K training actually had me SMILING??? I couldn’t ask for a better motivator and kinder internal monologue. She’s so supportive and makes it actually fun?? She makes running feel so much more accessible and I’m actually looking forward to my next session.

reviews.title: Just do it!!
reviews.text: I’m someone who has a very hard time staying disciplined with working out and this app has made it easier and more convenient than anything else I’ve ever tried. The small sessions target a specific area (and yes you feel it) and fit right into my super busy schedule. Feels very accessible too!

reviews.title: Long time listener, first time caller
reviews.text: I’ve watched Cam develop this app thru her social media presence, but never pulled the trigger for myself. As a busy mom, seeing other busy moms prioritize their health and wellness helped me understand the importance for myself, too. I’ve loved the layout with energy levels as someone who rarely gets a full night’s sleep. Thank you Can and Julie for this way to strengthen myself and show my kids it’s ok to take time for myself.
Amazing app with an amazing message

reviews.title: Great for pregnancy
reviews.text: Starting this second trimester. I have had HG and haven’t been able to be active. But these videos are perfect pace for me to get back into just moving my body and not laying in bed. I feel so accepted and supported by Cam. Loving it.

reviews.title: Best version of myself
reviews.text: Mila has shown and continuing to show me grace for myself each day. How I show up every day is enough! Mila has opened my eyes that all movement counts and listening to my body is more important than pushing to extremes. I am rewriting my relationship with movement and with Camilla in my ear guiding me it’s a voice in my head I welcome! Thank you Mila!

reviews.title: Amazing app
reviews.text: Absolutely love Camilla and the Mila App! Makes working out so accessible and enjoyable. Would recommend to anyone!

reviews.title: Best I Have Felt Working Out💗💗
reviews.text: I am not new to working out, used to do a lot of sports growing up. I fell out of it a few years back (okay maybe more like 5) and it has been a struggle to get back into the swing of things. Camila was amazing, her talk through my first ever guided run really helped quiet the voices that got me out of working out in the first place. Can’t wait to do more, and watch her platform continue to grow💗

reviews.title: Love love love MILA!
reviews.text: I’ve never been able to keep a consistent workout schedule for myself until I downloaded Mila. Now I’ve been able to maintain a manageable workout schedule and come back to it after getting sick. Camilla is an incredibly accessible trainer and guide and the Mila mindset makes it possible to rewrite your relationship with movement and healthy habits. Thanks for creating this product Cam and Julie ♥️

reviews.title: Different than most
reviews.text: First workout app that I haven’t quit or felt defeated by in the first week. Over 100 days in and ready to keep going. Cam is so motivating.

reviews.title: Life Changing
reviews.text: This app has changed my life in so many ways. I never thought that I could be a person to crave working out and I am becoming that person. I can show up however I want and get movement into my body that is meaningful and productive. Thank you MILA for making movement accessible and exciting!!

reviews.title: Mila is life changing
reviews.text: As someone who’s gone back and forth with exercising, then quitting and feeling bad about it, Mila has been an absolutely life changing. Camilla has built something truly amazing here. I’ve learned so much, not just about exercising, but about my lifestyle, about giving myself grace, and about self confidence. I recommend Mila to everyone I know who struggles to exercise or doesn’t even know where to get started. Have I also gone back and forth with Mila a few times? I have, but I always feel welcomed back and reminded that it’s okay to take a break. The days I’ve shown up for myself will never reset, because every day counts.

reviews.title: absolutely adore Camilla 🥹
reviews.text: I’ve been a long time follower of Camilla and Julie. I have always admired how both of them approach the world and was blown away by how that approach worked for fitness too. The mindset of growth instead of focusing on weight loss has really reshaped how I’m looking at my own wellness journey. I just finished my first guided walk and it genuinely felt so much easier than doing it on my own! Really looking forward to exploring more of the app!

reviews.title: Mentally and physically supportive workouts
reviews.text: It has been incredibly hard to show up and work out as a mom of very young kids. My goal has been to show up for myself and my family to improve my overall health. Camilla is incredibly kind and motivating. She does a great job of adapting the workouts to different levels. It allows you to feel like you can personalize your workout and still feel good about showing up.

reviews.title: Mila is a warm embrace
reviews.text: Mila has allowed me to fall back in love with moving my body in a way that makes me love what I can do. I’m never focused on calories or looks, but smiling, laughing, or working on my relationship with movement. This app is y truly a mental health gift.

reviews.title: Great for Starting out and staying consistent!
reviews.text: So I’ve had a really hard time getting back into keeping in shape and I really love the way this app is structured in a way that promotes consistency rather than pushing too hard. This is by far the longest period of time that I’ve been able to workout everyday for this long and I found out that works so well for me, I’ve been getting amazing progress. Thank you Camilla!

reviews.title: I love this app!
reviews.text: This app has helped me have the motivation to move my body! I love using it and the way that Camilla talks on there makes my heart so so happy!

reviews.title: Talk about HOLISTIC wellness!
reviews.text: Camilla pours all her knowledge and compassion into this app. It’s not just about movement, but shifting how you think and feel about yourself. I have a mental health background and I am consistently impressed with the sage words that come along with (and without!) the movement she is guiding us through. If you are looking to improve your physical AND mental health, then look no further! I love love Camilla and this resource!!

reviews.title: In love with it
reviews.text: I’ve followed Camila and Julie for a while now and ever since I saw them launch Mila I wanted to try it. After having two c sections 1 unplanned after a home birth that didn’t go how I wanted it to and another one pretty much back to back for my second child it made me want Mila even more. After finally getting the money put aside and signing up I can’t believe how in love with these programs Camila and her team have made. The energy bar that they ask you to do before giving you the work outs is amazing, the positive messages and videos she gives you during and before your work out is amazing and makes me feel super proud and reminded how great I am every day I use it. The educational videos are super handy and helpful, it really made me reevaluate how and why I want to get back into shape which is for my sons and to feel good. Just want to say thank you so much to Camila, Julie and the rest of the team at Mila for making a super positive and helpful work out app that makes my life better and makes me smile while I work out.

reviews.title: So motivated!
reviews.text: Cam is the best, I come away feeling so good about the work I’ve put in for myself. I encourage anyone starting or starting again on their journey to movement to try this app ❤️

reviews.title: LOVE MILA
reviews.text: This is my favorite workout app I have used so far! It's so positive and encouraging and customizable! I love it! Highly recommend for anyone wanting to get back to movement or into it for the first time or just looking for a great community!

reviews.title: Exactly what I needed
reviews.text: I’m 13 months post partum and this is the first physical movement I’ve done since birth that didn’t feel like I was doing it because I hate myself but instead because I love the body that created life. They say you cry after your first workout with Cam and I can say if you have had any past body issues, you’ll cry but in the best way possible. Now my daughter will get to see a strong and happy mom who enjoys movement, not one who dreads it

reviews.title: The BEST movement app
reviews.text: Camilla has made me like moving my body again for the first time since I was a kid!!! It really feels like having a friend guide me to be my best self.

reviews.title: The best workout app!
reviews.text: I give this app 5 stars because Camilla takes the time to make you feel special and proud of yourself, in many ways. She applauds you while working out, too!Her other instructors are absolutely AMAZING, as well. Which is a bonus :)

reviews.title: Great For Beginners
reviews.text: I think this app is wonderful for people who are truly just starting out in fitness and wanting to workout for the first time. There’s variety, it’s supportive, and it’s accessible. That being said, after giving it a go I cancelled my membership because even if I combined 4+ workouts I wasn’t feeling challenged or seeing progress. I’ve been doing weight workouts with varying regularity for the last 4 years, so I found this just didn’t get me sweating as much as I wanted it to. But again LOVELY option for people new to fitness! I did really like the guided runs :)

reviews.title: one step at a time…
reviews.text: this app continues to change my life for the better. thankful

reviews.title: So wonderful!
reviews.text: I’ve struggled to go to the gym and figuring out know what to do, Camilla does a wonderful job of explaining not only the movements but how to position yourself, and as a neurodivergent and hypermobile person that’s so helpful!

reviews.title: Don’t Bother
reviews.text: Waste of time and money…

reviews.title: BEST APP EVER
reviews.text: I love this app so so much! I have multiple chronic illnesses and workouts are not easy for me but cam is so inspiring and she has workouts for both my bad medium and good days. If you’re considering buying this let this review be your sign! You won’t regret it!!

reviews.title: Back at it
reviews.text: Genuinely lovely app and lovely videos. I had been a fitness instructor for 10 years but over the last 3 years due to health issues had strayed from my wellness journey. When I was well enough to come back I discovered Camilla and this app and am so in love - the presentation is gentle and kind with a focus on wholesome wellness. Love that I can choose my energy level for the day and it curates ideas and videos for me. Feels so supportive and was just what I needed to build good habits again. Highly recommend to all my friends. Thank you for making a platform like this x

reviews.title: One of a kind!
reviews.text: Not just a workout app, it does SO much more for mental health and overall wellbeing! Amazing can't get enough of it!

reviews.title: Mila has changed my life!
reviews.text: At first it may seem like just another fitness app, but it’s so much more. It’s a healing from diet and fitness culture. It’s an introduction to moving with your body not against it. Ignore everything you’ve ever learned and just focus on how Camilla guides you. Your body will get stronger and so will your heart and mind.

reviews.title: Love love love!!!!
reviews.text:
Over the years I have focused on different types of exercising and my dedication has always fluctuated through those different styles. I have been a cardio bunny, power lifting, Pilates, and weight lifting, and Mila is the first exercising app that I’ve been excited to open and use daily. After a hard moment in life I spent months doing nothing. I knew I needed to get back into moving my body and healing my self talk and this app does both. Throughout the day I hear Camilla’s voice reminding me that I can do hard things and that’s it’s okay to adjust things to my body instead of making my body adjust to it. 

The interface at first was a wee bit confusing but after just spending time and clicking around I figured out the flow of the app and I’ve been recommending it to everyone I know who wants to get back into working out and wanting a non judgmental space to do that!

I love this app and what you guys are doing at Mila and I can’t wait to see how you grow!

reviews.title: Mila makes movement easy
reviews.text: I’ve struggled with consistent movement for my entire adult life. I’ve tried a few apps and online things but none have ever stuck. The way Mila breaks it up into small different workouts and only a few moves/reps each makes it so much less intimidating for me. I don’t dread doing it or put it off because I don’t think I can handle it. The way Camilla talks you through each workout and encourages you puts it over the top. I’m so glad I took the leap and joined.

reviews.title: LOVE Mila
reviews.text: Mila is the first fitness app I have had success in. I consistently can move my body and feel good about it because of Camila and her coaching. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Mila has changed me
reviews.text: The diverse workouts, the encouragement, the community as a whole has helped me be consistent with showing up for me and becoming a better and healthier person

reviews.title: First guided walk
reviews.text: Me, my cousins and her kids took their dog for a walk. It was very nice and listening to this was nice too. I may have gotten a little distracted by the kid and the dog but it was still a good walk.

reviews.title: Best app ever !
reviews.text: I am so glad I downloaded this app because it is just what a needed on my health journey. Camilla’s inspiring videos and positive reinforcement make this app truly one of a kind. It’s like having a friend guide you through workouts. I definitely recommend to try it out !

reviews.title: Best non weightloss app 😉
reviews.text: I’ve only watched the first 5min introduction video. But it made me cry. I feel so seen and this is exactly what I needed in my life.

reviews.title: Just wow
reviews.text: I don’t know how to express the level of care I feel for being a user on this app, I just joined but having the goals set for the day based on your energy level while also having the activities that are built to prioritize building up your strength and not just telling you it’ll be easier the more you do their program is so empowering. The reassurance of Camila and the talking to everyone whether they’ve done stuff like this or not is so sweet. And the reassurance at the end of the videos really just adds to the experience as a whole. Thank you 💙 as a plus sized girly who is not comfortable in a gym setting most of the time I very much appreciate the space to learn and grow

reviews.title: Love Mila!
reviews.text: Love this app so easy to use and beginner friendly! Camila is so encouraging and makes it so fun and low pressure!

reviews.title: First time in my life I’ve worked out consistently
reviews.text: I’ve always struggled to make a habit of working out bc everything felt too hard or overwhelming but with Mila you go at your own pace and build from there. I’m finding myself actually excited to workout and notice a dip in my mood if I skip it. Seriously this has been life changing for me I can’t recommend it enough

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: I really love this app, I really love Camilla! Super helpful to exercise in a space that is so affirming and healthy in every way 💙

reviews.title: Day 1
reviews.text: I’ve only done 1 session so far but Mila already has me feeling more excited for tomorrows session!

reviews.title: Left and came back
reviews.text: I joined Mila last winter and really enjoyed the yoga and office-friendly workouts during my work week. I fell out of using the app for a while and did not renew when it came time. Well, I’ve really missed it and I’ve seen all the things they’ve added, so I’m back! I’ve blocked times off on my calendar to move and I’m hoping it keeps me accountable and I stick with it 😊.

reviews.title: Sweating right now
reviews.text: Could cry. This is amazing. Love you Camilla.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Camilla is so encouraging and this has given me beautiful guidance and prompting in beginning to start moving my body with “lower commitment.” Happy as can be!

reviews.title: Great for beginners!
reviews.text: Honestly I’m not all that active but being walked through each exercise like I’m capable of doing something more can be discouraging. Not with this, I love being given alternatives and it’s not making me feel like I’m over doing it but like I’m going at a good pace! Also I found it a lot easier to follow along and love how you’re asked about what your energy levels are before you do a work out! Love this app!
